environment.description: Service runs on ECS Fargate in an isolated subnet (no NAT, no IGW). Accessible exclusively through a VPC Interface Endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with endpoint policy restricting principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/MigrationOrchestrator. The ENI attached to the VPC endpoint has security group sg-0xdeadbeef which permits inbound TCP/8443 only from 10.0.47.0/28 (the migration orchestrator's subnet CIDR). Route table for the service subnet contains only local VPC routes - no 0.0.0.0/0 destination exists. Additionally, the VPC endpoint service requires manual acceptance of connection requests and has a notification configuration that alerts on new connections.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate in isolated private subnet (no IGW, no NAT gateway)
config.network_access: AWS PrivateLink VPC Interface Endpoint only
config.route_table: Only local route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local), no internet route
config.connection_acceptance: Manual acceptance required for new VPC endpoint connections
config.subnet_type: Isolated (no NAT, no IGW attachment on VPC for this subnet)
